name: Oni-Con
blurb: Houston's annual Japanese pop-culture and multi-genre fan expo, held at the Houston Marriott Westchase.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Oni Con 2027 October 1st - 3rd Houston, TX' and 'Where Houston Marriott Westchase 2900 Briarpark Dr Houston, TX 77042'.

notes: This edition is about a year out: the nav has no 'Guests' link at all yet (only General/Cosplay/Accessibility/Press/Volunteer/Vendor), and a direct /guests URL 404s, so no lineup has been announced. Despite the batch note's hiatus history, the site shows an open, actively-promoted 2027 date with registration and vendor/artist applications already live, so it is treated as active. Organizer name isn't stated on-site; the con describes itself only as an 'Annual Japanese Pop Culture & Multi-Genre Fan Expo' based in Houston. No og/twitter image is set, and the homepage's two sizeable images have no filename or alt text to confirm which is key art versus a logo; the wider, non-square one (hero:1) was picked as the more banner-like candidate.
